text: Core courses Mathematics Analysis, Analytic Geometry, Higher Algebra, Probability and Mathematical Statistics, Ordinary Differential Equation, Operations Research, Elementary Number Theory, Modern Algebra, Complex Functions, Selected Elementary Algebra, Selected Elementary Geometry, Higher Geometry, History of Mathematics, Basic Humane Social Sciences. Objective This objective is to train students to obtain the fundamental theories, knowledge and methods of mathematics, so that after graduation students have ability to use math and computer knowledge to solve actual mathematical issues and serve as math teachers, or math teaching-oriented research personnel or other-type-educational staff in junior and senior high schools, or schools of higher learning. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Science is granted.
